(CURRENTLY AMENDED) A system for treating obesity, the system comprising: a gastric space filler comprising a first balloon connected to a second balloon by a conduit, wherein the gastric space filler is configured to occupy a substantial volume of a gastric cavity in the human patient in an inflated state; and an instrument throughput channel extending through the conduit, wherein the instrument throughput channel is configured to receive instruments, and wherein the instrument throughput channel extends along an axial length of the conduit.

(CURRENTLY AMENDED) The system of claim 35 wherein the first and second balloons are made from at least one of the following: silicone, latex, polyethylene, polyurethane, nylon, or combinations thereof.
